Name: Stardew Valley Explained
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
How can your cows get pregnant if they’re all female? Where are the villagers’ bathrooms? Who put Krobus’s name on the calendar?

Whether you’re looking for these answers yourself or just need a handy link to throw at a wiseass on social media, this mod has you covered!
Stop living in the dark! [b][i]Stardew Valley Explained[/i][/b] will explain all sorts of things that never actually needed explaining!

[b][size=6]L[/size][size=5]atest Update[/size][/b]
The 1.1.0 update answers two more questions asked by inquisitive souls.
[spoiler]Moxie69 asks:
[size=4][b]Could you maybe add an explanation as to what Pierre's secret stash is?[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Have seen Pierre's "secret stash" event.
Have reached 8 hearts with Pierre.
Visit Pierre's store between 6 AM and 5 PM when Pierre is there.[/spoiler]
Kalmek asks:
[size=4][b]How did Lewis' pickup truck get there?[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Have reached 8 hearts with Lewis.
Visit the Town between 6 AM and 7 AM.[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]E[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]vents List[/color][/size]
[/b]Including those in the latest update, the mod currently adds 7 new events that answer the game's greatest unsolved mysteries. Have a question you don't see answered here? Fire them away in the comments section. Your idea might just be in the next update!
[spoiler][size=4][b]How do your all-female cows get pregnant?[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Have talked to Marnie.
Have built at least one barn.
Visit the Forest between 6 AM and 4 PM on days when Marnie attends her shop.[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Where are the villagers' bathrooms?[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Have reached 8 hearts with Evelyn.
Visit Evelyn's house when Evelyn and George are there.[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Who put Krobus's name on the calendar?[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Have seen Krobus's event with the Dwarf.
Visit the town between 6 AM and 5 PM during winter, before the 17th.[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Is that an [i]actual[/i] rabbit's foot?[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Have reached 8 hearts with Jas.
Have Rabbit's Foot in inventory.
Visit the Forest between 12 PM and 3 PM when Jas is there.[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]And seriously, Demetrius... the tomatoes?[/b][/size]
[spoiler]Have seen the fruit debate event.
Have reached 8 hearts with Demetrius.
Visit Robin's house when Demetrius is there.[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]
